measurement_notes: Timing runs are sequential. Allocation and sampled-heap profiles run separately.
This retains the final harness; original and final-verification stages are separate raw series from harness development.
Native projection is a valid-input lower bound, not a compatible replacement for the sandbox and reader.
sample 0 is the first evaluation; paired runs alternate variant order and report a separate warm-up pair 0.
Trace session_open_ms includes Mix/VM startup through session-started. process_peak_rss_bytes is whole-process macOS time -l maximum RSS, not live heap.
Trace CLI evaluation durations are copied from bounded analysis responses. No raw trace or inspection contents are parsed by these benchmark scripts.
The LRU series models hit counts for three identical sequential passes; it is not a measured cache.
The full-inspection Dispatcher control uses a 200 MB inspection ceiling, without changing production limits.
tprof allocation words below exclude prelude compilation but include Lisp.run setup and execution; do not compare directly to PROFILE.md open/eval/close totals.
runtime_change: TraceLog.runs/2 computes {parsed_start_timestamp, run_id} sort keys once per run summary with Enum.sort_by/3, instead of reparsing in every comparator invocation.

problems: The analyzer appears to rank countries by raw fraudulent volume, but the official fraud definition is fraudulent volume divided by total volume; this can produce a wrong top-country conclusion. For these measurements, BE has a slightly higher fraud ratio than NL despite NL having the larger raw fraudulent volume.
